user_goal.text: My last 3 amazon orders were for my roommates and me. The total cost is to be equally shared among all of us. Make venmo requests, one for each of my roommates, with a description note, "Amazon Purchases" and their share of the expense.
user_goal.rationale: This is the exact frozen official AppWorld instruction.

benchmark_success.rationale: AppWorld TestTracker success is exactly pass_count == num_tests, so every frozen registered test must pass.
